import json, subprocess, sys, copy

MAIN = "/work/submission/main.py"

def run_raw(raw):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN], input=raw, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

def expect_invalid(name, raw):
    rc, out, err = run_raw(raw)
    ok = rc == 2
    try:
        j = json.loads(out)
        ok = ok and j == {"error": "invalid-input"}
    except Exception:
        ok = False
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + name, "" if ok else "rc=%r out=%r err=%r" % (rc, out[:200], err[:200]))

def expect_valid(name, raw):
    rc, out, err = run_raw(raw)
    ok = rc == 0
    try:
        json.loads(out); ok = ok and "error" not in json.loads(out)
    except Exception:
        ok = False
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + name, "" if ok else "rc=%r out=%r err=%r" % (rc, out[:200], err[:200]))

BASE = {"version":1,"n":3,"capacity":[2,2,2],
 "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
          {"u":1,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"}],
 "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":10,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}

def mut(**kw):
    d = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
    for k, v in kw.items():
        if k == "root":
            d = v
        else:
            d[k] = v
    return json.dumps(d).encode()

# valid baseline
expect_valid("baseline", mut())

# version
expect_invalid("version 2", mut(version=2))
expect_invalid("version true", mut(version=True))
expect_invalid("version float", mut(version=1.0))
expect_invalid("version str", mut(version="1"))

expect_invalid("n=97", mut(n=97))
expect_invalid("n str", mut(n="3"))

expect_invalid("capacity 49", mut(capacity=[2,49,2]))
expect_invalid("capacity -1", mut(capacity=[2,-1,2]))

d = copy.deepcopy(BASE); del d["rounds"]

expect_invalid("duplicate root key", b'{"version":1,"version":1,"n":3,"capacity":[2,2,2],"edges":[],"rounds":[]}')
expect_invalid("root not object", b'[1,2,3]')
expect_invalid("root string", b'"hello"')

expect_invalid("edge extra key", json.dumps(d).encode())
d = copy.deepcopy(BASE); del d["edges"][0]["label"]

big = b'{"version":1,"n":3,"capacity":[2,2,2],"edges":[],"rounds":[],"pad":"' + b'x'*2200000 + b'"}'
